lines.trans: This work is a story based on true events.

words.gram: Past た-form of する (to do/happen).

lines.trans: Today I will show all of you the world beyond censorship.
The path I have walked is the very history of adult video.
So today, please allow me to speak about myself.
I have shot one thousand eight hundred adult videos.
Today this industry is major entertainment worth fifty billion yen.
Just what is the driving force that keeps you going, Mr. Muranishi?
Anyone with ordinary nerves would never show their face so boldly in public.
Yet I never give in to despair.
Because nothing is ever born out of despair.
After all, in prison I was called the idol of fellow inmates.
Life is a game of pleasing one another.

words.gloss: game of making each other happy
